posts.post:
the most expensive item you own is usually the one you wear the least.

it’s always the $50 basic that ends up doing the heavy lifting.

why is the hardware on $500 jackets always the first thing to fail?

it’s frustrating to have perfect fabric paired with a zipper that sticks every time.
sitting in a meeting realizing your shirt is slightly too short and now you’re hyper-aware of every movement for the next hour.

spent all morning debating whether to add a small internal pocket to the new trousers.

decided against it. keeps the silhouette cleaner, but i’m still second-guessing it.
